body.x: INNOSIMULATION, participated ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ held at COEX in Samseong-dong from October 17th (Tue) to 20th (Fri) and introduced various experience system that has applied the VR.

INNOSIMULATION, is the company that makes VR based simulator, and have introduced the programs such as industrial forklift and excavator that enables to experience the VR. In addition, it has also introduced 4D products, that gives liveliness with the moving chair.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
